item.title: Binance Casino: A Complete 2026 Guide
item.description: The rise of cryptocurrency gambling has introduced new concepts to online gaming, and the term Binance casino is increasingly searched by players worldwide.

item.title: Maintaining Visual Consistency Without an In-House Illustrator
item.description: Growing teams face a difficult question: how do you maintain a strict visual language without the overhead of building a proprietary icon set?

item.title: Valley Community Outreach hosts successful food drive
item.description: Valley Community Outreach, now in its sixth year, hosts a Valley Sportsplex food drive.

item.title: West Point discusses major redevelopment efforts
item.description: West Point officials outline redevelopment priorities, from assembling 10th Street land for major projects to advancing design for a Marriott hotel at the former Coca-Cola site.

item.title: GVJC awards two scholarships to high school seniors
item.description: Greater Valley Juneteenth Celebration names Lanett High’s Carington King and Springwood’s Jonas Camp as 2026 Essie Mae Harris Community Servant Scholarship recipients.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Dean Collins: All Our Springs Are in You
item.description: Dean Collins reflects on how God sustained Israel in the wilderness and what their water, wells, and worship teach about God's ongoing provision in our lives.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Michael Brooks: Memories From The Opelika Hospital
item.description: A pastor's vivid memories at an Opelika hospital—from watching Reagan’s 1981 shooting unfold to an unexpected $20 bill—spark reflections on suffering, gratitude and God’s surprising gifts.

item.title: LaFayette council delays waterline decisions
item.description: LaFayette council delays waterline plans, tabling two engineering proposals until after a Feb. 25 town hall on water issues, while also addressing local honors, board seats and feral cat control.

item.title: Kia Georgia celebrates major milestones
item.description: Kia Georgia marks five million vehicles built in West Point with the 2027 Telluride, the first hybrid electric vehicle produced in Georgia and in the U.S., marking a milestone for state manufacturing.

item.title: LaFayette boys, Lanett girls advance to the Final Four
item.description: LaFayette boys edge Lanett in OT to reach Final Four; Lanett girls roll past Highland Home to punch their own Final Four tickets in Birmingham.
